# Specify input and output directory
```{r input and output directory, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# codebase directory
codebase_path = "/scratch/data-integration/molecular_subtyping/public_testing/codebase"
hallmark_database_path = "/scratch/data-integration/pipelines/Interpretation/remapped_databases/hallmark0522.rds"
kegg_database_path = "/scratch/data-integration/pipelines/Interpretation/remapped_databases/kegg0522.rds"

# intermediate output directory
out_path = "/scratch/data-integration/molecular_subtyping/public_testing/intermediate_output_public"
```

# Load in MOFA Data and Construct MICA factors
```{r factor construction}
require(openxlsx)
library(ade4) #used in mcia
library(mogsa)
source(paste0(codebase_path,"/data_analysis_template_codebase.R"))
source(paste0(codebase_path,"/codebase_basic.R"))
source(paste0(codebase_path,"/codebase_prediction.R"))
source(paste0(codebase_path,"/codebase_interpretation.R"))
source(paste0(codebase_path,"/class_structures.R"))
source(paste0(codebase_path,"/codebase_mod.R"))
organized_data = readRDS(paste0(out_path, "/organized_data.rds"))

####construct factors
rank_max = 100
x.mcia = list()
D = length(organized_data$datasets_imputed)
data_list = list()
for(d in 1:D){
  data_list[[d]] =organized_data$datasets_imputed[[d]]
  x.mcia[[d]] = t(data_list[[d]])
}

x.mcia =nsc_prep(data_input=x.mcia, rank_max)
x.mcia = processOpt(x.mcia,scale=FALSE,center=FALSE,num_comps=rank_max,option= 'lambda_all')
mcia_model <-mbpca(x.mcia,ncomp=rank_max,k="all",method="globalScore", option="uniform",center=FALSE,scale=FALSE,
                                                            unit.p=TRUE,unit.obs=TRUE,moa=FALSE)
mcia_factors=new_gs(x.mcia,mcia_model)


mcia_projection_evaluation = projection_coef_func(mcia_factors=mcia_factors,
                                datasets=data_list)

mcia_results = list(mcia_factors=mcia_factors, 
                    mcia_model = mcia_model,
                    clinical_data = organized_data$clinical_data,
                    mcia_factor_evaluation = mcia_projection_evaluation)

saveRDS(mcia_results, file = paste0(out_path, "mcia_results.rds"))
```

# Enrichment Analysis for Selected MCIA Factors
```{r enrichment}
library(clusterProfiler)
data_env0 <- readRDS(paste0(out_path, "/data_env.rds"))
mcia_results = readRDS(paste0(out_path, "mcia_results.rds"))
kegg_database = readRDS(kegg_database_path)
hallmark_database = readRDS(hallmark_database_path)
metabolite_row_DF = data_env0$plasma_metabolomics_global_rowfeature
rownames(metabolite_row_DF) = metabolite_row_DF[["CHEMICAL_NAME"]]
metabolite_row_DF=metabolite_row_DF[,c("CHEMICAL_NAME","SUB_PATHWAY","SUPER_PATHWAY")]
subpath_databse = list()
subpath_databse[["pmg"]] = data.frame(description =metabolite_row_DF[["SUB_PATHWAY"]],
                                      CHEMICAL_NAME = metabolite_row_DF[["CHEMICAL_NAME"]])

mcia_output=mcia_results
omics_used_DR = c(
  "ppt" = "plasma_proteomics_targeted",
  "ppgd" = "plasma_proteomics_global_dda",
  "so" = "serum_olink",
  "pmg" = "plasma_metabolomics_global",
  "nt" = "nasal_transcriptomics",
  "pbmc" = "pbmc_transcriptomics"
)
omic_short_names = names(omics_used_DR) %>% setNames(omics_used_DR)
omic_names =c("plasma_proteomics_targeted","plasma_proteomics_global_dda",
              "serum_olink","plasma_metabolomics_global","nasal_transcriptomics",
              "pbmc_transcriptomics")  
projection_coef = convert_mciaObj_to_annotation_format(mcia_output$mcia_factor_evaluation$projection_coef, omic_names = names(omics_used_DR))
projection_pval = convert_mciaObj_to_annotation_format(mcia_output$mcia_factor_evaluation$projection_pval, omic_names = names(omics_used_DR))
K = 10
projection_coef=projection_coef[1:40]
projection_pval=projection_pval[1:40]
for(mod_id in c(1:40)){
  mod_name = paste0("mod", mod_id)
  print(mod_name)
  projection_coef[[mod_id]]= coefficient_name_translator(data_env = data_env0, projection_coef_factor = projection_coef[[mod_id]], omic_names = omic_names) 
  projection_pval[[mod_id]]= coefficient_name_translator(data_env = data_env0, projection_coef_factor = projection_pval[[mod_id]], omic_names = omic_names)
}

short_list_features = list()
mag_thr = 0.3; adjp = 0.01
 use_assay = 1:6
for(mod_id in c(1:K)){ 
  ###extract coefficients for relevant module
  tmp_coef = projection_coef[[mod_id]]
  tmp_pval = projection_pval[[mod_id]]
  short_list_features[[mod_id]] = list()
  short_list_features[[mod_id]][["unsigned"]]=cutlist(
    projection_coef = tmp_coef , 
    projection_pval = tmp_pval, 
    mag_thr = mag_thr, FWER_thr =adjp, direction = NULL)
  
  short_list_features[[mod_id]][["pos"]]=cutlist(
    projection_coef = tmp_coef , 
    projection_pval = tmp_pval, 
    mag_thr = mag_thr, FWER_thr =adjp, direction =1)
  
  short_list_features[[mod_id]][["neg"]]=cutlist(
    projection_coef = tmp_coef , 
    projection_pval = tmp_pval, 
    mag_thr = mag_thr, FWER_thr =adjp, direction =-1)
}
lapply(  short_list_features,function(z) sapply(z[[1]],dim))
short_list_features[[2]]$unsigned$pmg[order(short_list_features[[2]]$unsigned$pmg[,1]),,drop = F]
short_list_features[[2]]$unsigned$ppgd[order(short_list_features[[2]]$unsigned$ppgd[,1]),,drop = F]
short_list_features[[2]]$unsigned$ppt[order(short_list_features[[2]]$unsigned$ppt[,1]),,drop = F]
short_list_features[[4]]$unsigned[[6]][order(-abs(short_list_features[[4]]$unsigned[[6]][,1])),,drop = F]

enrichment_mhg_list = list()
enrichment_mhg_list[["kegg"]] = list()
enrichment_mhg_list[["hallmark"]] = list()
enrichment_mhg_list[["subpath"]] = list()
for(mod_id in 1:K){
  list0 =  short_list_features[[mod_id]]
  tmp_coef = projection_coef[[mod_id]]
  #KEGG
  enrichment_mhg_list[["kegg"]][[mod_id]] = list()
  enrichment_mhg_list[["kegg"]][[mod_id]][["pos"]] = runMGH(short_list_coef=list0[["pos"]][use_assay],  Term2GeneList = kegg_database,
                                                            projection_coef=tmp_coef, backround = "impacc")
  enrichment_mhg_list[["kegg"]][[mod_id]][["neg"]] = runMGH(short_list_coef=list0[["neg"]][use_assay],  Term2GeneList = kegg_database,
                                                            projection_coef=tmp_coef,backround = "impacc")
  print(lapply(enrichment_mhg_list[["kegg"]][[mod_id]][["pos"]], function(z) head(z[,c("ID", "pvalue","p.adj")])))
  print(lapply(enrichment_mhg_list[["kegg"]][[mod_id]][["neg"]], function(z) head(z[,c("ID", "pvalue","p.adj")])))
  #hallmark
  enrichment_mhg_list[["hallmark"]][[mod_id]] = list()
  enrichment_mhg_list[["hallmark"]][[mod_id]][["pos"]] = runMGH(short_list_coef=list0[["pos"]][use_assay],  Term2GeneList = hallmark_database, projection_coef=tmp_coef, backround = "impacc")
  enrichment_mhg_list[["hallmark"]][[mod_id]][["neg"]] = runMGH(short_list_coef=list0[["neg"]][use_assay],  Term2GeneList = hallmark_database,  projection_coef=tmp_coef,backround = "impacc")
  
  print(lapply(enrichment_mhg_list[["hallmark"]][[mod_id]][["pos"]], function(z) head(z[,c("ID", "pvalue","p.adj")])))
  print(lapply(enrichment_mhg_list[["hallmark"]][[mod_id]][["neg"]], function(z) head(z[,c("ID", "pvalue","p.adj")])))
  
  ##SUBPATHWAYS
  enrichment_mhg_list[["subpath"]][[mod_id]] = list()
  enrichment_mhg_list[["subpath"]][[mod_id]][["pos"]] = runMGH(short_list_coef=list0[["pos"]],  Term2GeneList = subpath_databse,  projection_coef=tmp_coef,backround = "impacc")
  enrichment_mhg_list[["subpath"]][[mod_id]][["neg"]] = runMGH(short_list_coef=list0[["neg"]],  Term2GeneList = subpath_databse,  projection_coef=tmp_coef,backround = "impacc")
  
  print(lapply(enrichment_mhg_list[["subpath"]][[mod_id]][["pos"]], function(z) head(z[,c("ID", "pvalue","p.adj")])))
  print(lapply(enrichment_mhg_list[["subpath"]][[mod_id]][["neg"]], function(z) head(z[,c("ID", "pvalue","p.adj")])))
}

saveRDS(enrichment_mhg_list, file = paste0(out_path, "enrichment_mhg_list.rds"))
```
